facts: GNSS reference frame for GB is ETRS89
OS mapping uses OSGB36 British National Grid
mainland GB orthometric heights use Ordnance Datum Newlyn
OSTN15 links ETRS89 and OSGB36 National Grid
OSGM15 links GNSS ellipsoidal heights to mean-sea-level height datums
OS reports OSGM15 standard error for Great Britain as 0.008m
OS Net base-station coordinate standard errors are generally better than 0.008m plan and 0.020m height
simple spreadsheet transformations should not be used when better than 3m accuracy is required
Lite developer pack has lower horizontal accuracy than full transformation
National Grid easting/northing may carry optional ODN height
WGS84 navigation coordinates are not interchangeable with survey-grade ETRS89/OSGB36 without controlled transformation

promotion_rule: No parcel height result may be promoted when horizontal or vertical datum transformation lineage is unknown.
